# ⚙️ Complete Modern C++ (C++20/23) Systems Track

Welcome to your full Modern C++ learning workspace materialized with **Trak**.

## 📚 Comprehensive Module Index

| Module | Title | Key Topics Covered |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-and-cmake-toolchain` | **Setup & Toolchain** | Compilation stages (Preprocessor, Compiler, Assembler, Linker), CMake, g++ / clang++ |
| `01-memory-layout-pointers-references` | **Memory Layout** | Stack vs Heap, BSS/Data/Text segments, Pointers (`T*`) vs References (`T&`), pointer arithmetic |
| `02-auto-decltype-constexpr` | **Type Deduction** | `auto`, `decltype`, `const`, `constexpr`, `consteval` compile-time computations |
| `03-strings-and-string-view` | **Strings & Views** | `std::string` (SSO) vs `std::string_view` (zero-copy fat pointer view) |
| `04-control-flow-and-init-statements` | **Control Flow** | `if` with initializers (`if (auto it = m.find(); ...)`), range-based for loops |
| `05-functions-lambdas-functional` | **Lambdas & Functions** | Lambdas `[captures](params)`, `std::function`, generic lambdas |
| `06-raii-and-smart-pointers` | **RAII & Smart Pointers** | RAII idiom, `std::unique_ptr`, `std::shared_ptr`, `std::weak_ptr` cycle prevention |
| `07-move-semantics-rule-of-5` | **Move Semantics** | Rvalue references (`T&&`), `std::move`, Rule of 0 / 3 / 5, perfect forwarding |
| `08-oop-vtables-polymorphism` | **OOP & Vtables** | Virtual functions, `vptr` & `vtable` mechanics, virtual destructors, object slicing, diamond problem |
| `09-templates-and-cpp20-concepts` | **Templates & Concepts** | Function/class templates, template specialization, C++20 `concept` and `requires` constraints |
| `10-stl-containers-deep-dive` | **STL Containers** | `std::vector` capacity doubling, `std::unordered_map` bucket hashing & rehash, `std::map` RB-tree |
| `11-stl-algorithms-and-ranges` | **STL & C++20 Ranges** | `std::sort`, `std::transform`, C++20 `std::ranges` pipeline view composition |
| `12-error-handling-and-std-expected` | **Error Architecture** | Exceptions, `noexcept`, `std::optional`, C++23 `std::expected` |
| `13-multithreading-mutexes-atomics` | **Concurrency** | `std::jthread`, `std::mutex`, `std::lock_guard`, `std::unique_lock`, `std::atomic<T>` |
| `14-cpp20-modules-architecture` | **C++20 Modules** | `export module`, `import`, zero header include overhead |
| `15-filesystem-and-file-io` | **Filesystem & I/O** | `std::filesystem::path`, `std::fstream`, recursive directory iteration |
| `16-testing-and-sanitizers` | **Testing & Sanitizers** | AddressSanitizer (`-fsanitize=address,undefined`), unit tests |
| `17-interview-questions-and-drills` | **Interview Master Drill** | Top 10 high-yield C++ interview questions & low-level memory traps |

---

## 🛠️ How to Compile & Run

Compile any module with g++ (C++20):
```bash
cd 00-setup-and-cmake-toolchain
g++ -std=c++20 main.cpp -o main
./main
```

# 00 - C++ Toolchain & Build System 🛠️

### The 4 Compilation Stages:
1. **Preprocessor (`-E`)**: Expands macros, `#include` files.
2. **Compiler (`-S`)**: Generates assembly code.
3. **Assembler (`-c`)**: Generates machine object code (`.o` / `.obj`).
4. **Linker**: Combines object files and libraries into an executable.

### Build with CMake:
```bash
cmake -B build
cmake --build build
```

- `std::weak_ptr<T>`: Non-owning observer to break cyclic shared_ptr references.
